$comment: Licence policy for the npm dependency tree (scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs, the 'Dependency licences' job of ci.yml). A package passes when its licence expression is satisfied by 'allowed' (OR: one allowed alternative is enough; AND: every part must be). 'allowedDevelopmentOnly' lists licences accepted for build and test tooling as a class: a package under one passes only when it is absent from the production tree. A package outside both lists is refused until it is reviewed: either the identifier joins a list, or an entry goes into 'exceptions' with the package, the exact licence string pnpm reports, and the reason; an exception with 'onlyRequiredBy' stops applying when a package it does not name depends on it directly. The project is source-available: no copyleft licence enters the tree without a decision.

exceptions.reason: The Inter font files, shipped unmodified with the desktop and admin apps. A font licence that asks for no source disclosure of the software around it.

Reaches the tree only through the Prisma command-line tool's Studio (@prisma/studio-core, required by prisma). No code of this project imports it and it is in no client bundle; it sits unmodified in node_modules because the server image carries the Prisma CLI for migrate deploy.
